mapper.select: SELECT record_code FROM ingest_record ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ingest_record WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(data_size_bytes), 0) FROM ingest_record WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(1) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(data_size_bytes), 0) AS totalSize FROM ingest_record WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT execute_status AS status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM ingest_record GROUP BY execute_status

SELECT t.datasource_id, d.datasource_name AS datasourceName, COUNT(r.id) AS ingestCount, IFNULL(SUM(r.data_size_bytes), 0) AS totalSize FROM ingest_record r LEFT JOIN ingest_task t ON t.id = r.task_id LEFT JOIN datasource_config d ON d.id = t.datasource_id GROUP BY t.datasource_id, d.datasource_name ORDER BY totalSize DESC
